# Ogg Vorbis test fixture

`cc0_laser.ogg` is a tiny CC0 test clip from the
[ignition-bench/sound-library](https://github.com/ignition-bench/sound-library),
`sounds/LASERS/LASRGun_LaserSmall01_Kenney_KenneySciFi.ogg` (CC0 1.0).
It is kept here only to test the Ogg decoder path; it is not part of the
sample picker library.
